blurb: Guests can enjoy sightseeing cruises, fishing trips, dolphin watch tours, sunset cruises, and boat rentals departing from historic Tin City in Naples. Tours include narration on local history, wildlife, and ecology, with opportunities to see dolphins, manatees, and native birds. Specialty cruises include holiday boat parades, dog-friendly cruises, and New Year's Eve fireworks cruises.
